plain: Reading the reasoning a model writes before it acts, to catch bad intent before it turns into a bad action.
eli5: Reading someone's scratch paper to see what they are planning before they do it.
technical: Using a human or automated monitor over a model's externalised reasoning to detect intent to misbehave; it works to the extent that hard tasks force the model to reason in legible text (monitorability), and can fail if reasoning is unfaithful, obfuscated or moves into latent computation.
